title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Simple suggestion: Eat in hawker centres. It’s street food, but inside dedicated squeaky clean centres. And they cover all cuisines Singapore is famous for including Chinese, Malay, Indian, and fusions of these.
A word of caution about hawker centres: they don’t provide tissues for free (sometimes at all), so carry some with you.
